headline: Hajduk bring the form to Thun; the market stays close
summary: Conference League leaders Hajduk Split arrive at Thun on a run of four wins in five, including a 2-1 home victory over Ajax and a 2-1 win over Dinamo Zagreb. Thun have not won in their last three, and at Twente they created only 0.2 expected goals. Their coach has pushed back on the idea that Hajduk are clear favourites, and the market is not far from his view: Hajduk's win chance is 41.2%, up from 39.9% in recent days, with a fair handicap of just 0.18 goals. Both teams to score is rated 62.5%, and the goals line sits at 3.0, with over at 48.6%.
read: Hajduk Split arrive as Croatian league leaders on a four-in-five run, having beaten Ajax and Dinamo Zagreb in the last fortnight, while Thun have one win in five and were well beaten on chances by Twente. The market still sees it as close: Hajduk favourites at 41.2%, with a fair handicap of about a fifth of a goal and a 3.0 goals line leaning towards the under.

facts.fact: Hajduk have won four of their last five, including a 2-1 home win over Ajax on 15 October and a 2-1 win over Dinamo Zagreb.
facts.meaning: The visitors arrive in strong form against decent opposition, having beaten both Ajax and Dinamo in the last fortnight.

facts.fact: Hajduk are rated 41.2% to win in Thun, against 32.9% for the home side.
facts.meaning: The market makes Hajduk the favourites, but not overwhelming ones, despite the gulf in recent form.

facts.fact: Thun have won one of their last five, drawing 2-2 at Schaffhausen in the cup on Sunday and losing 0-1 at Twente in Europe.
facts.meaning: The hosts come in on a poor run, and only drew in the cup against lower-league opposition four days ago.

facts.fact: At Twente, Thun created just 0.2 xG and allowed 2.32.
facts.meaning: Their European opener was a one-sided match in terms of chances even though the scoreline was only 0-1.

facts.fact: The Asian handicap fair line sits at +0.18 home, meaning the market rates Hajduk roughly a fifth of a goal better than Thun.
The market's goals line is 3.0, with Over at 48.6%.
facts.meaning: The books lean slightly towards under three goals, in line with the expectation of a controlled European tie.

facts.fact: The market has both teams to score at 62.5%.
Thun coach Privitelli pushed back on Croatian journalists' suggestion that Hajduk are favourites, according to Blick.
facts.meaning: The hosts are framing themselves as competitive at home, not as a side already beaten.

sources.fact: Thun coach Privitelli pushes back on Croatian journalists' view that Hajduk are favourites.
Thun player Nicolas Bürgy says even a draw against the Ajax-beating Hajduk side would be valuable.
The match is treated as a high-risk game, with Bern cantonal police visibly present in Thun on Thursday after Hajduk fans chanted Nazi slogans before the Ajax match.
Thun are checking their own fans' loyalty before the visit of Hajduk, with fans puzzled by special controls.
Thun are described as struggling, in contrast to Lugano's unbeaten domestic run.
Hajduk Split are the Croatian league leaders coming to Thun, and are described as having consistently been among the top contenders domestically in recent years.
Hajduk beat Ajax in their Conference League MD1 match in Split on 15 October 2026.
Croatian police arrested at least a dozen Hajduk fans a day after supporters held an anti-Semitic rally, clashed with officers and interrupted the Ajax match.
